title: R64 conditional follow-up: narrow primary sources
selection: Reuse two directly relevant sealed sources and add one original gradient-cache paper. No broad search, new feature proposal or literature-based hyperparameter choice.

sources.title: The Cramer Distance as a Solution to Biased Wasserstein Gradients
sources.locator: Abstract; precise earlier theorem locators retained in sealed report.json.
sources.supported_fact: Empirical Wasserstein gradients need not be unbiased for the population Wasserstein objective.
sources.use_here: Motivates keeping finite empirical-reference error separate from population-gradient claims.
sources.limit: Not a result about R63's five losses, ADC STE, B=128, training trajectory or A–F.

sources.title: Minibatch optimal transport distances; analysis and applications
sources.authors: Kilian Fatras, Younes Zine, Szymon Majewski, Remi Flamary, Remi Gribonval, Nicolas Courty
sources.locator: Introduction (minibatch expectation changes the problem); Section 4.2, Theorems 29–30, Definition 32, Eqs.44–46.
sources.supported_fact: Under stated regularity and integrability assumptions, minibatch stochastic derivatives target the expected minibatch objective; that objective differs from transport between the original measures.
sources.use_here: A=average four D32 and B=joint D128 are distinct reductions; neither is automatically an unbiased full-F or population gradient.
sources.limit: Its smooth-model/generalized-derivative assumptions cannot be asserted for R63's hard ADC plus chosen STE. No monotone finite-batch improvement or project acceptance guarantee is imported.

sources.title: Scaling Deep Contrastive Learning Batch Size under Memory Limited Setup
sources.authors: Luyu Gao, Yunyi Zhang, Jiawei Han, Jamie Callan
sources.supported_fact: Cache representations without encoder graphs, compute their loss derivatives jointly, replay sub-batch encoder graphs with cached derivatives, accumulate, then update once.
sources.official_code_provenance: Linked by the paper at footnote 1; not downloaded or executed for this report.
sources.use_here: A method-level precedent for endpoint-gradient/VJP splitting in a loss that couples samples.
sources.limit: Its task is contrastive learning. Applying the factorization to R63 is a project-specific inference requiring exact objective, randomness, state, projection and ADC replay checks. Its memory/speed numbers are not R63 measurements.

local_definitions.role: sealed artificial-only preparation receipt; not actual R63 replay proof
